title: KU Lawrence campus events to honor military service around Veterans Day
summary_en: Observances recognize veterans, active-duty service members, National Guard and Reserve members, military-affiliated students and military families whose service and sacrifice have strengthened the university, the state of Kansas and the nation.
title_cn: KU Lawrence campus events to honor military service around Veterans Day

title: Spencer Lecture to feature ‘Dark Laboratory’ author Tao Leigh Goffe
summary_en: The Commons at the University of Kansas will welcome author and interdisciplinary artist Tao Leigh Goffe to present the annual Kenneth Spencer Lecture. The event will take place at 7 p.m. Nov. 9 at Liberty Hall in downtown Lawrence.
title_cn: Spencer Lecture to feature ‘Dark Laboratory’ author Tao Leigh Goffe

title: Comparative law scholar to discuss corporate law, governance
summary_en: Afra Afsharipour will present “Comparative Corporate Governance and the Pathology of Controlling Shareholder Power” at 3:45 p.m. Nov. 12 in 107 Green Hall. The public is invited to attend the free lecture and reception to follow. Registration is requested.
title_cn: Comparative law scholar to discuss corporate law, governance

title: Humanlike design of AI voice assistants helps users disregard security risks, study finds
summary_en: New research from Andrew Chen, Ronald G. Harper Professor at the University of Kansas School of Business, finds that humanlike voice qualities significantly increase perceived enjoyment of artificial intelligence-based voice assistants, which in turn reduces both perceived security risk and user intention to discontinue using the tool.
title_cn: Humanlike design of AI voice assistants helps users disregard security risks, study finds
